claims.text: The Pulumi for Terraform Users guide teaches how to reference existing Terraform state files from Pulumi.
Any Terraform provider can be used in Pulumi programs.
Terraform modules can be imported and used directly in Pulumi.
HCL code can be converted to Pulumi.
Terraform and Pulumi deployments can be orchestrated together.
`new pulumi.StackReference("core-infra")` with `getOutput("vpcId")` retrieves an output from another Pulumi stack.
The `terraform.state.S3Reference` resource in `@pulumi/terraform` takes `bucket` and `key` arguments to reference Terraform state stored in S3.
`S3Reference` exposes a `getOutput(name)` method for reading Terraform state outputs.
The `aws.ecs.Cluster` resource accepts a `configuration.executeCommandConfiguration` argument with `kmsKeyId` and `logging` properties (logging value "DEFAULT").
`pulumi import` can be used to bring Terraform-managed resources under Pulumi management.
State ownership can be transferred from Terraform to Pulumi gradually, resource-by-resource.
The `pulumi import` command takes the form `pulumi import <type-token> <name> <id>`, e.g. `pulumi import aws:ec2/vpc:Vpc main-vpc vpc-12345`.
`terraform.state.S3Reference` has a `getOutput("resources")` that returns a filterable array of resources with `type` and `name` properties.
Pulumi policies (Policy as Code) can enforce infrastructure policies across both Terraform and Pulumi resources.
`@pulumi/policy` exports `PolicyPack` and `validateResourceOfType`, and policies use `enforcementLevel: "mandatory"` and `validateResource` with `reportViolation`.
The `aws.s3.Bucket` resource has an `acl` property with values like "public-read" and "public-read-write".
The Pulumi Automation API allows embedding Pulumi in applications for dynamic infrastructure management.
`@pulumi/pulumi/automation` exports `LocalWorkspace.createOrSelectStack` taking `stackName`, `projectName`, and `program`.
`terraform.state.S3Reference` is accessible as `pulumi.terraform.state.S3Reference` from the `@pulumi/pulumi/automation` import.
`stack.setConfig("aws:region", { value })` and `stack.up({ onOutput })` are valid Automation API methods, with `up` returning a result with `outputs`.
Component resources can integrate with Terraform behind the scenes, leaving multi-tool management complexity to platform teams rather than development teams.
`pulumi.ComponentResource` constructor is called via `super(type, name, {}, opts)` with `pulumi.ComponentResourceOptions`.
`aws.ecs.TaskDefinition` accepts `family`, `networkMode`, `requiresCompatibilities`, `cpu`, `memory`, and `containerDefinitions` arguments.
`aws.ecs.Service` accepts `cluster`, `taskDefinition`, `desiredCount`, `launchType`, and `networkConfiguration` with `assignPublicIp`.
